title: Your Bones Make 2–3 Million Blood Cells Every Second
lines: What happens inside your body in a single second?
pushing out about {70 milliliters~seventy milliliters} of blood.
Your fastest nerve signals hit {120 meters~a hundred and twenty meters} per second,
fast enough to cross a soccer field | in under a second.
You have about {25 trillion~twenty-five trillion} red blood cells.
It makes {2 to 3 million/~two to three million} new ones | every second.
Every day, you replace about {330 billion~three hundred thirty billion} cells,
about {1%~one percent} of you, | {4 million~four million} every second.
By the end of this video, | you're not quite the same person who started it.
How many times will your heart beat in a lifetime? | About {3 million~three million}, or about {3 billion~three billion}? | Tell me in the comments.

preroll.line: Right now, your body is replacing almost {4 million~four million} cells, every second.
